claim_integrity: Conditional mathematical theorem for an instantaneous gross-production formula; no original field data, no biological growth inference, independent validation not performed.
date_basis: A day-resolved first-publication record (1974-03-01) is available for the Thornley paper. Earlier foundational papers by Steele (April 1962) and Bannister (January 1974) show month-only publication dates in inspected publisher records; no exact day is imputed.
scientific_limitations: Requires two strictly positive irradiance levels and duty probabilities strictly between zero and one
Uniform biomass, fixed physiologic optimum, frozen local response, exponentially attenuating vertical illumination
Time integration assumes quasi-static photosynthetic response; light-frequency dependence and acclimation excluded
No empirical calibration or guarantee for alternative P–I curves
Historical priority remains provisional for incompletely available 1974, 1975 and 1997 full texts
title: A one-cutoff law for two-level light fluctuations in a Steele–Beer water column
